title: IBM API Connect 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote attacker to access internal network resources and…
description: IBM API Connect versions 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 contain a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to bypass protections blocking requests to internal network addresses. This flaw enables the attacker to make the server contact internal services and retrieve partial responses, potentially exposing sensitive information.
